scope: Freshly reconstructed focused suite; complete standalone application and real registered pointer/touch/input/beforeinput/composition/keyboard handlers. Test-local DOM event/focus/task adapter and synthetic AudioContext sink only. No physical phone, native keyboard visibility, browser layout, browser activation or speaker claim.

results.name: Desktop tracker retains piano mapping, navigation, cut, clear and no automatic advance
Desktop envelope painting and ordinary text fields keep their original behavior
Rejected separate note and envelope forms are absent
A stationary touch focuses a real text input synchronously without changing the model
Pen and touch-event fallback select the requested cell and request keyboard focus
Scrolling and canceled gestures do not focus or replace an existing keyboard session
Multi-touch cancels both pointer and touch-fallback keyboard activation
Header, outside-grid and other-tab taps leave the keyboard and project inactive
Compatibility mouse events cannot steal native focus; later desktop clicks still work
Native text input uses all PC piano keys and canonical selected-instrument mutations
Android Unidentified and keyCode 229 defer mutation until native input arrives
Cancelable deletion applies once across beforeinput and its same-task input echo
Noncancelable and input-only deletion fallbacks use the original cut and clear commands
Composition is provisional, commits one note at end and suppresses a microtask echo
Explicit trailing composition echoes stay suppressed until a new ordinary edit
Composition cannot commit into a different row, channel, order or replacement project
Native Done commits a single provisional note and dismisses the keyboard
Escape cancels a composition even when the keyboard marks it as IME keyCode 229
Paste, drop, replacement, cut and bulk text never become an unintended note importer
Blur, tab change and visibility loss stop native edits and leave other fields isolated
Project replacement and canonical Undo invalidate a stale native typing session
Ctrl and Command shortcuts invoke real Undo, Redo and protected Save As
Native history events use canonical history with no duplicate same-task undo
Keyboard edits round-trip through project JSON while unsupported DPCM and missing instruments retain guards
